mentions.name: Lightpage
mentions.description: This is a personal notes app that "writes back" using LLMs: it reads the user's notes, ideas, and journal entries and proactively helps move things forward. A popular feature writes the user a "letter" every Sunday based on the past week's notes, and many early users use it as a journal.
mentions.problem: The author previously dumped personal notes, ideas, and journal entries into Apple Notes for its simplicity, but wanted LLMs to read those notes and proactively help move things forward as they get smarter.
mentions.audience: The author's own use; early users primarily use it as a journal.
mentions.source_excerpt: Have been working on Lightpage for the past ~18 months. It's a personal notes app that "writes back" using LLMs.

evidence.value: Have been working on Lightpage for the past ~18 months. It's a personal notes app that "writes back" using LLMs.
